root_cause.proven_llvm_mos_abi: The compiler-generated call in vm_install_staged_boot_overlay places p in __rc2/__rc3 and n in A/X; the ov_crc16 prologue consumes that layout.
root_cause.faulty_commit_call: At 0x2297..0x22a3, vm_boot_overlay_chain_commit places n=0x06c3 in __rc2/__rc3 and p=0xc356 in A/X.
root_cause.effect: ov_crc16 reads from the length value as an address and treats the Workbench VMA as the length, so the comparison with the correct expected CRC 0xa0f8 must fail even though the copied payload is correct.
root_cause.why_the_generic_error_appears: The commit leaf leaves VM_BOOT_OVERLAY_ERR_CRC without setting a Lisp error. vm_install_staged_boot_overlay returns nonzero, and main therefore records LISP65_ERR_STDLIB_BOOT_OVERLAY (0x23).

required_class_c_correction.product_change: At the sole assembly callsite, place Workbench VMA 0xc356 in __rc2/__rc3 and Workbench length 0x06c3 in A/X before jsr ov_crc16.

CRC parity must include the actual 1731-byte Workbench payload.
